title: Wound Care Supply Program Tier Placement Schedule
content:
# Wound Care Supply Program — tier placement schedule

The Wound Care Supply Program is offered in six tiers. Each tier is the payer program of the coverage a wound care program bills, and each tier has an entry gate: the coverage record it requires (plan type and coverage order), any further entry requirement, and the clinical qualification the wound must meet.

| Tier | Coverage record named on the program | Further entry requirement | Clinical qualification |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | none — no coverage record is named | a written order is required | — |
| Wound Care Commercial HMO Program | plan type commercial HMO, coverage order primary | a network referral is required | a chronic wound under practitioner care |
| Wound Care Commercial PPO Program | plan type commercial PPO, coverage order primary | — | a chronic wound under practitioner care |
| Wound Care Medicare Advantage Program | plan type Medicare Advantage, coverage order primary | — | a wound caused or treated by surgery or debridement |
| Wound Care Original Medicare Program | plan type Medicare Part B, coverage order primary | — | a wound caused or treated by surgery or debridement |
| Wound Care Medicaid Program | plan type Medicaid, coverage order primary | — | a chronic wound under practitioner care |

## Reading the schedule

- Every insured tier is entered on a coverage record whose coverage order is primary; no row of the schedule is entered on a secondary coverage record.
- The Wound Care Self-Pay Program is the only row entered with no coverage record named.
- The clinical qualifications fall into two groups: the commercial HMO, commercial PPO and Medicaid tiers name a chronic wound under practitioner care; the Medicare Advantage and Original Medicare tiers name a wound caused or treated by surgery or debridement.

## Placement examples (hypothetical coverage records)

| Coverage record named on the program | Row of the schedule it matches |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO, primary | Wound Care Commercial PPO Program |
| Medicare Part B, primary | Wound Care Original Medicare Program |
| Medicaid, primary | Wound Care Medicaid Program |
| No coverage record named | Wound Care Self-Pay Program |
